name: builtin-argument
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
math.abs("wrong")
end
end

name: builtin-count
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
math.abs()
end
end

name: local-assignment
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
local count: number = "wrong"
print(count)
end
end

name: declared-return
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): number
return "wrong"
end
end

name: field-return
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): string
return self.x
end
end

name: field-call
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
string.lower(self.x)
end
end

name: field-write
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
self.x="wrong"
end
end

name: computed-field-write
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
self["x"]="wrong"
end
end

name: typed-parameter-call
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self, text: string): ()
math.abs(text)
end
end

name: nested-closure
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
local function nested(): () math.abs("wrong") end
nested()
end
end

name: capture-self
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
local function nested(): number return self.x end
string.lower(nested())
end
end

name: valid-field-return
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): number
return self.x
end
end
assert(Box {x=42}:value()==42)

name: valid-field-write
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
self.x=42
self["x"]=43
assert(self.x==43)
end
end
Box {x=1}:value()

name: valid-parameter
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self, count: number): ()
math.abs(count)
end
end
Box {x=1}:value(42)

name: valid-shadow-self
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
local self={x="ok"}
string.lower(self.x)
end
end
Box {x=1}:value()

name: valid-later-self
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(item: number, self: string): ()
math.abs(item)
string.lower(self)
end
end
Box.value(42,"ok")

name: valid-no-self
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(): number
return 42
end
end
assert(Box.value()==42)

name: valid-capture-self
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): number
local function nested(): number return self.x end
return nested()
end
end
assert(Box {x=42}:value()==42)

name: valid-body-local-scope
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
local count: number=42
math.abs(count)
end
end
local count: string="ok"
string.lower(count)

name: valid-parameter-scope
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self, count: number): ()
math.abs(count)
end
end
local count: string="ok"
string.lower(count)

name: valid-global-print
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
print(self.x)
end
end
Box {x=1}:value()

name: directive-suppresses-call
source:
class Box
public x: number
function value(self): ()
-- slua-lsp:disable-next-line call-argument-type-mismatch
math.abs("wrong")
end
end
nativeNote: LSP suppression is not a native Luau type directive.

name: directive-suppresses-write
source:

function value(self): ()

end
